name: EntropicMem
description: EntropicMem gives agents durable memory on this computer: SQLite facts with full-text search, a Markdown vault, entities and relations, a timeline, and review tools. The MCP server runs locally over stdio and makes no network calls. Install the command first: `pipx install https://github.com/Ufonik88/EntropicMem/releases/download/v3.0.3/entropicmem-3.0.3-py3-none-any.whl`, then run `pipx ensurepath` once (pipx and Python 3.10+; the server is standard-library only, so no extra is needed). On first use the server creates a new v3 store under ~/.entropicmem. An existing store is served as it is and is never migrated automatically.

prompts.text: What do you remember about the decisions we made on this project?
